Drug-specific resistance mechanisms in OC

Drug-specific resistance mechanisms in OC. A Mechanisms of platinum resistance include: transport protein(①SLC31A1 (SLC family) reduces intracellular DDP levels, ② ABCB1, ABCC1, and ABCG2 promote DDP efflux). ③GSTP1 promotes the metabolism of DDP and CBP. ④ERK activation leads to excessive activation of autophagy. ⑤Dysregulation of glucose metabolism, lipid metabolism (OCCC), and glutamine metabolism (endometrioid) affects drug resistance.⑥Resistance to cisplatin in OC is associated with up-regulation of miRNA21, miRNA-93, lnc RNA EBIC, and lnc RNA PVT1. ⑦Upregulation of PI3K/mTOR axis and inactivation of p53 allow cancer cells to evade apoptosis. B Mechanisms of taxane include: ①Increased expression levels of ABCB1 and ABCC1 and increased P-gp activity accelerate the efflux of PTX from cancer cells. ②Overexpression of CYP1B1 (cytochromeP450 enzyme, involved in drug metabolism) is associated with DTX resistance. ③Activation of the PI3K/Akt pathway promotes tumor growth, invasion and migration. ④Highly expressed CLU prevents the interaction of PTX with microtubules by binding to PTX. ⑤Cancer cells can activate autophagy pathway to promote resistance. C The mechanisms of resistance to anti-angiogenics mainly include: ①pharmacodynamic tolerance (drug tolerance was caused by the increased expression of VEGF and VEGF receptors), ②induction of hypoxia, ③tachyphylaxis (an acute decrease in the response to Bevacizuma after its administration), ④alteration of the neovascular architecture (remodeled neovascular architecture resulted in resistance to available antiangiogenic agents), ⑤redundant angiogenic factors (in addition to VEGF, many pro-angiogenic factors can also promote angiogenesis, such as FGF, PDGF), and ⑥increased perivascular cell coverage (perivascular cell coverage increases after bevacizumab treatment, affecting the intratumoral distribution of the drug). D The mechanisms of resistance to anti-angiogenics mainly include: Upregulation of ABCC1 promotes P-gp activity and promotes PARPi efflux. ②CSC enhanced ③HRR efficiency. ④Enhanced replication fork stability. ⑤Reduced PARP1 trapping limits the cytotoxicity of PARPi.⑥Deletion of PARG inhibits the capture of PARP1 on DNA by partially restoring PARylation. ⑦Activation of the ATR/CHK1 signaling pathway leads to global inhibition of cell cycle progression and local restoration of stalled replication forks. E ①Low PD-L1 expression level, ②low MSI-H, ③abnormal cGAS/STING signaling pathway, and ④heavy tumor burden lead to the resistance of OC to ICIs
